versions.changelog:
Initial release of yq-feishu-webhook-skill:

- Send Feishu (Lark) webhook messages in plain text, rich text (post), or interactive card formats.
- Supports image upload with tenant_access_token for image-rich messages.
- Comprehensive documentation for message structure, image handling, and message sample JSON included.
- Requires configuration of FEISHU_TENANT_ACCESS_TOKEN and user-provided Feishu Webhook address.
- Includes keyword triggers for various Feishu/Lark webhook message scenarios.
